title: IFRS 連結決算・開示リード / IFRS Financial Reporting & Disclosure Lead
description:
職務内容：
募集背景： 中外製薬はロシュ・グループの一員として、グローバル水準の財務報告体制の強化に取り組んでいます。新基準（IFRS第18号等）への対応やグローバル共通のERP基盤への移行など、経理を取り巻く環境が大きく変化するなか、IFRSに基づく決算・開示の中核を担い、ロシュや社内各部門と連携しながら変革を前に進めるプロフェッショナルを募集します。 入社後はプレイヤーとして実務をリードしていただき、将来的にはチームを率いる管理職、または高度な専門性で組織を牽引するプロフェッショナル職としてのご活躍を期待しています。 仕事内容： 【決算・開示】 ・IFRSに基づく連結・単体決算の取りまとめ ・決算短信、有価証券報告書等の開示書類の作成・レビュー ・ロシュへのグループレポーティング、監査法人対応 【会計アドバイザリー・プロジェクト】 ・重要取引に関する会計論点の検討、社内各部門への助言 ・新基準の導入対応、税務との連携 ・ロシュと連携したグローバルな会計・ERPプロジェクトへの参画 職種の魅力： ■ 日本トップクラスの製薬企業で、決算・開示の「当事者」になる 監査や助言の立場から一歩踏み込み、自ら会計判断を下し、決算から開示までを責任を持ってリードできます。研究開発型製薬企業ならではの高度な会計論点に向き合えます。 ■ ロシュ・グループの一員として、グローバル水準の実務を経験 ロシュの会計・財務チームと日常的に議論しながら、グローバル共通の基準・プロセス・システムのもとで実務を経験できます。ロシュファイナンスチームのメンバーと直接協働する機会もあります。 ■ 専門性を磨き、管理職・プロフェッショナル職の両面でキャリアを描ける まずは実務をリードするプレイヤーとして専門性を発揮していただきます。将来的には、チームを率いる管理職に加え、会計・開示の高度な専門性を武器に組織を牽引するプロフェッショナル職としてのキャリアも選択できます。 ■ メリハリのある働き方 フレックスタイム制（コアタイムなし）に加え、出社と在宅勤務を組み合わせたハイブリッドワークで、決算期と閑散期に応じて柔軟に働けます。 ---- Background to recruitment: As part of the Roche Group, Chugai is elevating its financial reporting to global standards. With major changes underway, including the adoption of IFRS 18 and the transition to a global ERP platform, we are looking for an experienced professional to play a central role in our IFRS closing and disclosure process and help drive this transformation alongside Roche and stakeholders across the business. You will start as a hands-on individual contributor leading day-to-day operations, with the opportunity to grow into either a people management role or a senior expert role. Description of work: [Financial Reporting & Disclosure] ・Lead the consolidated and standalone financial close under IFRS ・Prepare and review external disclosures, including quarterly earnings releases and the Annual Securities Report ・Own group reporting to Roche and manage the relationship with external auditors [Technical Accounting & Projects] ・Assess the accounting implications of significant transactions and advise business partners across the company ・Lead the implementation of new accounting standards and partner with the Tax team ・Contribute to global accounting and ERP initiatives in partnership with Roche Position Features: ■ Own the financial close and disclosure at one of Japan's leading pharmaceutical companies Move beyond an audit or advisory role: make the accounting calls yourself and take end-to-end ownership from close to disclosure. You will work on complex accounting topics unique to a research-driven pharmaceutical company. ■ Gain global experience as part of the Roche Group Work with globally harmonized standards, processes, and systems in regular dialogue with Roche's accounting and finance teams, including opportunities to collaborate directly with Roche Finance. ■ Build your career in management or as a technical expert Start as an individual contributor leading day-to-day work. Over time, you can move into a people management role or a senior expert role built on deep expertise in accounting and disclosure. ■ Flexible work Flextime with no core hours and a hybrid model combining office and remote work let you adapt your schedule to the peaks of the closing cycle and quieter periods.
応募資格( 経験/資格など )：
求める経験： 【必須】 ・監査法人、コンサルティングファーム、または上場企業の経理部門における経験（目安：通算7年以上） ・社内外の多様な関係者を巻き込み、主体的に業務やプロジェクトを推進した経験 【歓迎】 ・海外拠点やグローバル組織での就労経験 求めるスキル・知識・能力： 【必須】 ・会計・開示論点を自ら判断できる高度な会計知識（公認会計士／USCPA／ACCAレベル） ・スピーキングを含め、英語でのコミュニケーションに臆せず対応できること ・複雑な論点を整理し、関係者にわかりやすく説明できる力 【歓迎】 ・製薬業界のビジネスや特有の会計論点に関する知識 ・SAP等のERPの使用経験 求める行動特性： ・多様なメンバーの中でリーダーシップを発揮し、困難な状況でも粘り強く物事を前に進められる ・環境や優先順位の変化を前向きに捉え、柔軟に対応できる ・現状に満足せず、業務改善や生産性向上に自ら取り組める ・全体を俯瞰しつつ、細かな実務にも丁寧に向き合える 求める資格： 【必須】 ・ビジネスレベルの英語力（会議で議論できるレベル） ・ネイティブレベルの日本語能力（JLPT N1、または同等の能力） 【歓迎】 ・公認会計士、USCPA、ACCA等の会計資格 ---- Desired experience: [Required] ・7+ years of experience at an audit firm, a consulting firm, or in the finance/accounting function of a listed company ・Proven track record of driving projects and initiatives by engaging diverse internal and external stakeholders [Preferred] ・Experience working overseas or in a global organization Preferred Knowledge and Skills: [Required] ・Strong technical accounting knowledge, with the ability to independently form judgments on accounting and disclosure matters (Japanese CPA / USCPA / ACCA level) ・Comfortable communicating in English, including in spoken discussions ・Ability to distill complex issues and communicate them clearly to stakeholders [Preferred] ・Knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry and its specific accounting issues ・Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERP systems Desired competencies: ・Leads effectively in diverse teams and drives work forward with resilience, even in challenging situations ・Embraces change and adapts quickly to shifting priorities ・Continuously looks for ways to improve processes and productivity ・Balances big-picture thinking with strong attention to detail Desired Qualification: [Required] ・Business-level English (able to participate actively in meeting discussions) ・Native-level Japanese (JLPT N1 or equivalent) [Preferred] ・Professional accounting qualification (e.g., Japanese CPA, USCPA, ACCA)
待遇：
当社規定により優遇いたします。 To be decided in accordance with our criteria 勤務時間：フレックスタイム制（コアタイムなし） Flextime system 労働条件の通知は電子ファイルによって行います。 ご応募される場合は、その点につきご了承ください。 The notification of working conditions will be made in an electronic file. If you apply, please understand this point.
勤務地：
東京都中央区（本社） / Head Office (Chuo Ward, Tokyo) 事業所内禁煙 就業時間内禁煙（休憩時間と就業時間外は除く）

title: 【焼津・つくば】医薬品包装・デバイス開発担当_Packaging & Device Development Scientist
description:
General Information                                    
                                
                            

                            
                                
                                                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                    Job Advert Title:                                                
                                            

                                            
                                                【焼津・つくば】医薬品包装・デバイス開発担当_Packaging & Device Development Scientist
                                            
                                        
                                    
                                                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                    Location:                                                
                                            

                                            
                                                Tsukuba,Ibaraki / Yaizu,Shizuoka
                                            
                                        
                                    
                                                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                    Division:                                                
                                            

                                            
                                                Product Research & Development

                                                Permanent
                                            
                                        
                                                                    
                            
                        
                    

                                            
                            
                                
                                    
                                        
                                            Description                                        
                                    
                                

                                
                                    【募集の背景 / Purpose & Scope】本ポジションは、製剤研究所 包装＆デバイス研究室において、包装設計およびデバイス評価を通じて、製品品質、供給安定性、患者の利便性、ならびに環境面の持続可能性に貢献する役割を担います。チームリーダー等の指導・助言を受けながら、開発品および既上市品に関する包装・デバイスの設計、評価、工業化、技術移転、変更管理、安定生産支援を担い、専門性を活かしてプロジェクト推進に貢献します。This position within Packaging & Device, part of Pharmaceutical Research & Technology Labs, contributes to product quality, supply stability, patient usability, and environmental sustainability through packaging design and device evaluation. Under the guidance of senior team members, this role supports project advancement by undertaking the design, evaluation, industrialization, technology transfer, change control, and support for stable production for both development-stage and commercially marketed products.【職務の内容 / Essential Job Responsibilities】（雇入れ直後）・開発品および既上市品に関する包装設計、包装仕様検討、包装材料評価、包装工程適性評価、輸送・保管時の品質リスク評価を計画・実施する。・投与デバイス、容器・施栓系等について、製品特性および使用場面を踏まえた評価計画を立案し、機能性、信頼性、使用性、製造性、品質リスクの観点から評価を行う。・包装・デバイスに関する工業化検討、製造サイトへの技術移転、変更管理、安定生産支援に主体的に関与する。・自らの研究データおよび関連データを解析し、包装研究、デバイス評価、製品化ノウハウ開発に関する科学的・技術的判断を行う。・試験計画書、SOP、関連ガイドライン、社内手順に従い、生データ、評価結果、報告書類の信頼性を確保する。・研究、製造、品質、薬事、サプライチェーン、国内外の製造サイト、外部委託先等と連携し、担当テーマの課題解決を推進する。・予期せぬ技術課題や業務上の問題が発生した場合には、責任者へ速やかに報告し、技術的根拠に基づく対処策を提案・実行する。・メンバーや関係者に対して、試験計画、評価方法、データ解釈、文書作成および課題解決に関する技術的助言を行い、技術的観点から意思決定に貢献する。・Plan and execute packaging design, specification development, material evaluation, process compatibility assessments, and quality risk assessments during transportation and storage for development and commercial products.・Develop and execute evaluation plans for drug delivery devices and container/closure systems based on product characteristics and use scenarios, assessing functionality, reliability, usability, manufacturability, and quality risks.・Actively contribute to industrialization, technology transfer to manufacturing sites, change control, and support for stable commercial production.・Analyze experimental and related data to make sound sci

title: Rare Hematology Thought Leader Liaison
description: Job Title: Rare Hematology Thought Leader LiaisonLocation: US / Remote  Geography:  Gulf Coast RegionTravel: 60–80% travel expectedJob Type: Full Time About The Job: Sanofi focuses on developing specialty treatments for debilitating diseases that are often difficult to diagnose and treat, providing hope to patients and their families. Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. We accomplish our goals through world-class research, collaboration with the global patient community, and with the compassion and commitment of our employees. With a focus on rare diseases, oncology, immunology, and multiple sclerosis, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve. Sanofi's portfolio of transformative therapies, which are marketed in countries around the world, represent groundbreaking and life-saving advances in medicine. At Sanofi, we are committed to the growth of our people, connected in purpose by career, life, and health. Learn more at www.sanofi.com. The Rare Blood Disorders franchise is a patient-centric organization responsible for delivering the highest quality education and service regarding disease and treatment. The goal of the franchise is to penetrate existing and new markets to meet business goals by educating physicians and healthcare professionals on a portfolio of products while upholding the Company's mission and values. Sanofi's Rare Blood Disorders/Rare Hematology Thought Leader Liaison (TLL) is a field-based, commercial role responsible for engaging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to strategically inform market development across the rare hematology portfolio of products. The TLL is expected to possess a high level of clinical and customer knowledge, have experience with both field and headquarters protocols and procedures, and possess the drive and spirit to engage with healthcare professionals to help build educational platforms, generate insights, and inform local and national brand strategies, supporting the commercial success of the portfolio. The portfolio focus is primarily on Systemic Mastocytosis (SM) and Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP). The TLL will work closely, and within approved SOPs, with other field professionals including, but not limited to, Regional Business Directors, Area Business Managers, and Medical Science Liaisons, as well as home office-based colleagues in Marketing, Medical Affairs, Operations, and Market Access. A core responsibility of this role is driving SM and ITP market development within the assigned region — identifying KOLs and fostering multi-disciplinary connections across specialists who treat and manage SM and ITP patients. The TLL serves as a strategic partner to cross-functional commercial and medical teams. The TLL helps to shape brand strategy through insight generation, KOL engagement, and regional market development initiatives across the full rare hematology portfolio. Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs. About Sanofi: We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.  Main Responsibilities: A. KOL Development and Engagement: Work with cross-functional colleagues to coordinate function-specific activities aligned to business and customer needs.Identify, profile, and maintain long-term partnerships with KOLs and emerging leaders within the Hematology and Allergy/Immunology communities.Identify SM champions within the region.Engage in on-label conversations to gather insights on topics such as disease diagnosis and treatment, therapeutic options, and product positioning across SM and ITP.Execute unique, on-label, and strategic HCP programming (e.g., disease state and product) as determined by brand needs.Serve as a single point of contact to resolve commercial KOL issues.Execute a customer-centric, needs-based approach with targeted KOLs.Plan and execute KOL engagements and executive encounters at local, regional, and national conferences, field visits, and other venues as directed.Be a voice for allergy/immunology and hematology/oncology KOLs within the organization, sharing insights with key stakeholders and cross-functional partners to inform brand strategy. B. title: 【障碍者採用】 Associate for Cardiovascular Markeing 契約社員
description:
Job Description Summary

*本ポジションは応募の際に障碍者手帳をお持ちであることが必須要件となります。
チームの活動を支えることで、社内外の関係者との信頼関係を築き、業務の質を高めることができます。あなたの細やかな気配りと柔軟な対応力が、チームの成功に直結するやりがいのあるポジションです。自発的に動ける方、正確な事務処理が得意な方にとって、日々の業務が誰かの「助け」になる実感を得られる環境です。
 

Job Description

主な業務
・社内の業務手順、ガイダンス、およびSOP（標準業務手順書）に従い、事務手続きを行う
・作成した書類（契約書状など）をリスト化し、保存・管理する
・会議資料の準備、整理、印刷などの事務サポートを実施する
・経費精算システムを使用し、財務部門からの照会にも対応する
・マーケティングに関連する事務的な業務を行う

・部門横断調整、およびミーティングの企画と運営を行う
・チーム内で発生するアドミニ業務に柔軟かつ迅速に対応する

応募要件
・基本的なPCスキルをお持ちである方（Word, Excel, Power Point, outlook中級程度）

・チームワーク力、優れたコミュニケーション能力および対人スキル

・新しいことを学んで実践しようとする意欲

望ましい要件
・高い倫理観とコンプライアンス意識を有する方

・英語での読み書き

偽の求人広告や採用オファーにご注意ください

ノバルティスでは、当社名や幹部の名前を不正に使用して求職者をだます「採用詐欺」が発生していることを認識しています。

ノバルティスでは、面接なしに採用オファーを出すことはなく、候補者に金銭を要求することも決してありません。

title: Head of Strategy & New Products, Japan
description:
Job Description Summary

The Strategy & New Products Head is responsible for driving country-level strategic planning and growth initiatives, collaborating on early phase launch activities, and shaping the portfolio and pipeline, driving faster decisions and clearer accountability.  

 

This role ensures alignment with global and local stakeholders, supports the implementation of the overall growth strategy, and builds organizational capability for long-term portfolio success.
 

Job Description

1. Country Strategy, Strategic Planning & Growth 

Drive key initiatives and strategic projects to support the implementation of the overall growth strategy for the country 
Identify and evaluate strategic opportunities and revenue potential for continued future growth 
Coordinate yearly strategic planning processes, ensuring cross-functional and operational priority alignment 
Periodically assess organizational capability in line with overall strategy and market dynamics, proposing actions for improvement 
 

2. New Products (Early Launch, Portfolio & Pipeline) 

Co-evaluate and co-plan early launch product strategies aligned with key global and local stakeholders 
Collaborate with global and local cross-unit and cross-functional teams to drive early launch activities 
Co-develop commercialization strategies with BUs; support rollout of ONE Brand Plan approaches for key pipeline products 
Build and strengthen organizational capability for launch excellence across the country 
Provide input to the internal pipeline in alignment with the International operating model (e.g., IMB milestones) 
Supports & partner with global team in the evaluation of global external Corporate & Business Development (C&BD) opportunities by providing country-level perspective 
Contribute to long-term BU portfolio strategy development (5+ years) by providing country-focused input and integrating cross-functional insights 
 

Leadership & Culture 

Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams to drive the strategic priorities 
Build a high-performance culture, manage recruiting, performance, and coaching; develop critical capabilities and talent pipelines. 
Attract, develop, and retain top talent; strengthen succession plans and capabilities across the country organization. 
Role-model Novartis Leadership Expectations & Behaviours, inspire transformation and performance, and demonstrate self-awareness with a growth mindset. 

Key Performance Indicators :

Strategic Planning 

Timeliness and quality of strategic plans; 

Partnership with global & local stakeholders 

Early Launch 

Success of early launch initiatives; launch readiness metrics; Collaboration/partnerships across functions/units to drive joint outcomes 

Portfolio & Pipeline 

Quality and impact of pipeline input; successful integration of country insights into global plan 

Languages: 

English 
Japanese

Experience/Professional Requirement:  

Extensive (>10) years’ experience in leadership positions within the pharmaceutical or life science industry and/or consulting. Ideally should have both Pharma and Consulting experience 
Proven track record in strategic planning, portfolio management, or new product launches in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry 
Experience in early launch planning, commercialization strategy, and/or business development 
Strategic thinking and analytical skills: ability to synthesize complex data and market dynamics into actionable strategies 
Strong business acumen and understanding of the pharmaceutical market and product lifecycle 
Proven track record of leading cross-functional projects and collaborating with global and local stakeholders 
Project management: ability to drive multiple initiatives simultaneously and deliver results in a fast-paced environment 
Stakeholder management: strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills across diverse groups (global, country) 
Matrix leadership and talent development: building high-performance, diverse teams; coaching, succession planning, and influencing across complex cross-functional and regional interfaces 
Experience in change management and organizational development is a plus 
 

 

 

Skills Desired

Business Development, Business Strategies, Collaboration, Curious Mindset, Data Analytics, Decision Making, Finance, Go-to-Market Strategies, Influencing Skills, Leadership, Market Strategy, Operations Management, Prioritization, Project Management, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Partnership Development, Strategic Planning, Strategic Thinking, Strategy Development
